digest.component_or_area: bridge command surface and tracker sync
propositions: The bridge command surface provides a unified, provider-neutral interface for tracker sync operations through three supported channels: Python library, CLI under `rebar bridge`, and MCP server, all sharing the same core implementation

Legacy `reconcile` and `bridge-status` commands remain as explicit compatibility adapters with historical safe dry-run defaults and exit code translations (3, 4, 75) while canonical operations use 0, 1, 2 exit codes
Pause state is remote-persisted with reason tracking and mixed-version fleet compatibility; destructive repair operations no longer require external `gh` CLI dependency

Canonical operational selection uses `--max-changes`, `--only`, `--except`, and `--max-age` flags with plain-language help; argument-less `reconcile` remains non-mutating while argument-less `bridge sync` is the canonical mutating command

Python-owned tickets-branch delivery through `src/rebar/_store/push.py` eliminates workflow-local CAS retry loops; all installation paths (brew, pip, MCP-server) execute the same packaged Python implementation

Runner-neutral execution across local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments uses shared command/secret/timeout contracts; full-depth execution succeeds while shallow history fails with named diagnostics
